text:
```yaml
name: Spellcheck

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "**/*.md"
      - "**/*.toml"
      - "**/*.rs"
      - ".github/workflows/spellcheck.yml"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  spellcheck:
    name: Spellcheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run spellcheck
        uses: crate-ci/typos@master
        with:
          config: .typos.toml
```
